name: Hinomoto Hikari
source: The game's main heroine. Childhood friend of the protagonist, and best friend of Kotoko Minaduki. An energetic, cheerful, kind and selfless girl who loves running. She has a crush towards the protagonist ever since they were kids, and never could forget him even after being separated for seven years, from their 2nd year of Elementary School until their reunion in High School.
